findings.item: 8.3 short names in registry command/args/url tokens
findings.evidence: 0 of 195 scanned tokens match the 8.3 pattern (~digit). Detector validated first: synthetic controls 'C:\Users\PREKZU~1\AppData\Local\x.exe' and 'C:/PROGRA~1/tool/bin.exe' both fired SHORT83 in the same run. However the live process environment carries an 8.3 path: TEMP and TMP both = "C:\Users\PREKZU~1\AppData\Local\Temp" (observed via os.environ in this lane's probe) - any tool that derives registry paths from TEMP inherits short names at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Registry itself needs no 8.3 fix. Owner may optionally reset TEMP/TMP to the long form; low priority since no registry token embeds it.

summary: Scanned 81 servers (195 command/args/url tokens; 45 absolute filesystem tokens, 42 exist / 3 missing) with validated detectors. GROUND-TRUTH CORRECTION: the registry holds 81 servers, not 80 - video-agent-kit was added after the 05:41 snapshot (registry-inventory.json's 80 names are a strict subset). syncMode=source-only confirmed. Three registry entries are dead as-written and two map to live failed-connect servers: bedrock-claude points at a nonexistent tools/mcp/bedrock-claude-mcp/server.py (directory gone entirely), burp pins JDK 21.0.10.7 which has been replaced by 21.0.11.10, and kaggle points at a vanished Downloads\bionlp venv. No 8.3 short names anywhere in the registry (positive controls fired), though TEMP/TMP in the live environment is itself an 8.3 path (C:\Users\PREKZU~1\...). No C:/D: binary duplication across servers; D: carries only 3 payloads (cursor-bridge, dbx-ai, paper-search), and cursor-bridge/dbx-ai couple C: interpreters to D: payloads. 27 servers launch via bare PATH-resolved commands (npx x19, uvx x3, docker x2, python x1, cmd x1, gh-cli-mcp x1); 7 npm refs plus 2 docker refs float on @latest/:latest. zai-vision's cmd /c npx @latest double-indirection is a plausible contributor to its live CONNECTION_CLOSED. All url fields are clean http(s). Honesty ledger: first-pass RELPATH hits on @scope/pkg and registry.host refs were over-matches (reclassified by inspection); one intermediate probe's heredoc-mangled regex under-counted D: tokens and was overturned by a regex-free string compare plus dump grep (3).
